title: 第12章 英略社
content_zh:
这天夜里，樊三回到陆凤台面前，仔细禀报起来。
“李瑕出承平客栈，先是在城内找了间武器铺，花了十二贯买了一柄长剑，他还在武器铺门口与人聊了许久。”
陆凤台不厌其烦地问道：“与什么人聊？”
樊三道：“英略社那些闲人总在武器铺周围溜达，遇到有人买兵器便上前邀请入社……”
英略社是宋朝传承已久的民间习武组织之一，自从二百五十多年前《澶渊之盟》签订后，宋朝百姓保家卫国的豪情高涨，纷纷结社习武，苏东坡称这种风气为“戴弓而锄，佩剑而樵”。
虽然到了宋徽宗年间，因为起义不断开始禁止民间习武……但近二十年来蒙古屡次南侵，民间习武之风又涨，忠勇义士前扑后继地与之相抗。
总之宋朝开国以来虽然总受外敌欺侮，但那是朝廷方面的各种原因，大宋百姓却不背这个“文弱”的评价。
陆凤台和庐州城英略社的那些人也是相熟的，闻言问道：“李瑕加入英略社了？”
“没有。”攀三道：“但他和‘庐阳剑客’马秋阳比试了一下，马秋阳称他剑法了得，乃不出世的少年奇侠。”
“狗屁庐阳剑客，就是个无赖汉。”陆凤台问：“还聊了什么？”
“李瑕这人很奇怪，他似乎不太了解市井风俗，显得很谨慎，问买刀剑犯不犯《宋刑统》，还问有没有宵禁；另外，杏花堂的封郎中问他是否婚配，想把女儿嫁给他，他摇头拒绝了……”
陆凤台轻声嘟囔了一句：“只看相貌气度，封妙手那女儿还真就配不上他。”
“后来，李瑕与这些人聊得熟络之后，问他们最近有没有在城内看到生面孔，并拜托他们，若遇到口音奇怪的人就告诉他。”
“这没什么用，若这样能找到那些逃犯的话，我早就找到了……之后呢？”
“他买了些吃食和书，又回到了长丰巷，在巷子里……练武。”
“练武？”
“这样……”
樊三蹲下身子，脚向后一踢，上身俯低又撑起，再迅速跳起。
“我也试过，这动作看着简单却很累人。那小子厉害，我看他分明累极却始终不停，若不是有大毅力，一般的人真做不到他那样。”
“之后呢？”

“练过之后，他坐在长丰巷口的茶摊上吃东西，他给了摊贩几枚铜钱，但吃的是自己带的牛乳和鸡蛋等物，吃完了就看书。”
“什么书？”
“《三朝北盟会编》，我已经买了一本。”
攀三从怀中掏出一本书放在陆凤台案上，接着继续起来。
“到天色暗下来，他趴在茶摊上睡了一觉。等人家收摊了，他在长丰巷里尿了一泡，这才回了客栈。”
“尿呢？”
“我让冯胜盯着那地方，看夜里有没有人通过尿渍与他联络……”
陆凤台思考着，许久没有说话。
直到又有几个手下回来，汇报了聂仲由偷偷派出去的那个商队护卫的行踪。
“那人叫聂平，是聂仲由的一个远房族弟，任禁军队统。他今日偷偷翻出客栈，是到了城内的珠翠楼……嫖，天还没黑就回客栈了。但他一路上极是警觉，我们好几次都差点跟丢了。”
“嫖？”
“是。”
“真就只是嫖？中间没有从珠翠楼溜出去过？”
“确定，他至始至终都在珠翠楼里。我们询问过那妓子，聂平把自己情况全说了。”
陆凤台踱了几步，开口问道：“樊三，你怎么看？”
“两种可能。一是，聂仲由派了李瑕去联络那些逃犯，聂平偷偷溜出去只是为了嫖；二是，李瑕是个障眼法，聂平在找机会，他没脱离我们的视线就不会真的做什么。”
“我是问你怎么看。”
“聂平。”樊三道：“聂平才是那个真正会去联络逃犯的人，当然，我们可以把两个都盯住了再说……”
李瑕早早起来，绕着庐州城跑了一圈。
他终于得到了更多的自由。

在他离开了死囚牢、解下身上的镣铐之后，这次，他已可以随意离开聂仲由的视线、到外活动。
他也想过是否趁机逃走，不再跟聂仲由去北面冒险。
但他随即否定了这个想法。
守承诺是一方面，而离开聂仲由这个官方的人，他就只能当一个逃犯，那是更差的选择。
那么，眼下的问题只在于，如何找到那些大理来的人？
晨练、进食之后，李瑕把睡眼惺忪的白茂拉起来。
“带你到城里逛逛。”
白茂完全不知道大理高氏的事，以为呆在庐州城内只是为了休整，起来后就揉着眼睛抱怨个不停。
“刘金锁的呼噜声太狂了，我要不是为了我娘，我真走咧，没来由受这个罪。锁命金枪，唉，真是把我的命给锁了……”
李瑕恍若未闻，带着白茂一路又到了长丰巷附近。
他目光不停地梭巡着附近的人群。接着，从怀中掏出那枚铜牌，高高举起。
“我们到那边看个杂耍，再去酒楼里吃一顿怎么样……我说你咋不走了？”白茂问道：“你这举的什么？”
李瑕也不回答，道：“想去酒楼吃饭？你有钱吗？”
“你没有吗？”
“我没有。”
白茂眼珠子一转，嘻嘻笑道：“要有钱了也不难，但可以吗？”
“有人罩着我们，怕什么。”
“嘻，那便说定了……但你站在这里举着这个做什么？”
李瑕又不回答，这个坏习惯似乎是从聂仲由身上传染来的。
他目光梭巡了一会儿之后，像是发现了什么，放下手，把铜牌收进怀里。

“走吧。”
又带着白茂走了一段，李瑕忽然低声道：“今日带你出来，是聂仲由有事要你办……看到那边那个穿粗布短襟的汉子了吗？”
“看到了。”
“你不觉得奇怪吗？他脚下踩的是破草鞋，腰间却挂了一个荷包。”
白茂低声道：“是有些奇怪。”
“你去，把他偷了……”
吩咐了白茂之后，李瑕退了几步，走到街旁站着，继续扫视着街上的行人。
他眼神带着与年龄不符的锐利，如同一只苍鹰在寻找的猎物。
突然，街那边有人吼道：“小偷？！”
“来人，有小偷啊！”
李瑕转过头看了一眼，见那身穿粗布短襟的汉子已紧紧捉住了白茂的手，正在大声叫嚷。
不远处，有几个捕快在往这边赶来。
只匆匆一瞥，李瑕收回了目光，再次扫视着街上的行人们……
“偷东西啦！”
“捉住他！”
几个捕快扑了上去，一把摁住白茂，场面混乱起来。
“冤枉啊，我没偷他东西，我就是不小心撞了他，真的！”
白茂大喊着，又朝着天上大喊了一句：“快回去叫哥哥们来救我，我冤枉的啊……”
“别废话！把人带回去！”
“……”

人群中，樊三注视着这一幕，向同伴冯胜使了一个眼色，示意他马上去把这件事禀报给陆凤台……
content_en:
That night, Fan San returned to Lu Fengtai and reported carefully.
"Li Xia left the Taiping Inn and first found a weapons shop in the city. He spent twelve guan on a long sword. He also chatted with someone at the door of the weapons shop for a long time."
Lu Fengtai asked tirelessly: "Who are you talking to?"
Fan San said: "Those idlers from the Yinglue Society are always wandering around the weapon shop. When they see someone buying weapons, they come up and invite them to join the club..."
The Yinglue Society is one of the long-established folk martial arts organizations in the Song Dynasty. Since the signing of the "Chanyuan Alliance" more than 250 years ago, the people of the Song Dynasty have become more arrogant to protect their homes and country, and they have formed societies to practice martial arts. Su Dongpo called this custom "wearing a bow to hoe, and wearing a sword to chop wood".
Although during the reign of Emperor Huizong of the Song Dynasty, folk martial arts practice was prohibited due to continuous uprisings... However, in the past twenty years, Mongolia has repeatedly invaded the south, and the popularity of folk martial arts has increased again, and loyal and brave soldiers have rushed forward to fight against it.
In short, although the Song Dynasty has always been bullied by foreign enemies since the founding of the country, this was due to various reasons on the part of the court, but the people of the Song Dynasty did not bear this evaluation of "weak".
Lu Fengtai was also familiar with the people from the Yinglue Society in Luzhou City. Hearing this, he asked, "Has Li Xia joined the Yinglue Society?"
"No." Pan San said: "But he competed with Ma Qiuyang, the 'Luyang Swordsman'. Ma Qiuyang said that he has great swordsmanship and that he is an unprecedented young hero."
"That bullshit Luyang Swordsman is just a scoundrel." Lu Fengtai asked, "What else were we talking about?"
"Li Xia is a very strange person. He doesn't seem to understand the customs of the market very well, and he seems very cautious. He asked whether buying swords violates the "Song Xingtong" and whether there is a curfew. In addition, the doctor of Xinghua Hall asked him if he was married and wanted to marry his daughter to him. He shook his head and refused..."
Lu Fengtai murmured softly: "Based on looks and bearing, Feng Miaoshou's daughter is really not worthy of him."
"Later, after Li Xia got familiar with these people, he asked them if they had seen any new faces in the city recently, and asked them to tell him if they met anyone with a strange accent."
"It's useless. If I could find those fugitives this way, I would have found them long ago... What happens next?"
"He bought some food and books, then returned to Changfeng Alley and practiced martial arts in the alley."
"Practice martial arts?"
"This way..."
Fan San squatted down, kicked his feet back, lowered his upper body, raised it up, and then jumped up quickly.
"I've also tried it. This action looks simple but very tiring. That guy is amazing. I can see that he is very tired but he doesn't stop. If he doesn't have great perseverance, ordinary people really can't do what he does."
"What happens after that?"
"After practicing, he sat at a tea stall at the entrance of Changfeng Lane to eat. He gave the vendor a few copper coins, but ate the milk and eggs he had brought with him. After eating, he read a book."
"What book?"
"I have already bought a copy of "Three Dynasties Beimenghui Compilation"."
Pansan took out a book from his arms and placed it on Lu Fengtai's desk, then continued.
"When it got dark, he lay down on the tea stall and slept. After the stall was closed, he peed in Changfeng Lane and then returned to the inn."
"Where's the urine?"
"I asked Feng Sheng to keep an eye on that place to see if anyone could contact him through urine stains at night..."
Lu Fengtai thought about it and didn't speak for a long time.
Until a few more subordinates came back and reported the whereabouts of the caravan guard that Nie Zhongyou secretly sent out.
"The man's name is Nie Ping. He is a distant clan brother of Nie Zhongyou and is the commander of the imperial army. Today he sneaked out of the inn and went to the Zhucui Tower in the city to engage in prostitution. He returned to the inn before dark. But he was extremely alert along the way. We almost lost him several times."
"Whoring?"
"Yes."
"Is it really just prostitution? Didn't you sneak out of Zhucui Tower?"
"I'm sure, he was in Zhucui Tower from the beginning to the end. We asked the prostitute, and Nie Ping told him all about himself."
Lu Fengtai took a few steps and asked, "Fan San, what do you think?"? "
"Two possibilities. First, Nie Zhongyou sent Li Xia to contact the fugitives, and Nie Ping sneaked out just for prostitution; second, Li Xia was a deceiver, and Nie Ping was looking for an opportunity. He wouldn't really do anything until he was out of our sight. "
"I'm asking what you think. "
"Nie Ping. Fan San said: "Nie Ping is the one who really knows how to contact fugitives. Of course, we can keep an eye on both of them..."
Li Xia got up early and ran around Luzhou City.
He finally got more freedom.
After he left the death row and took off the shackles on his body, this time he could leave Nie Zhongyou's sight and move around at will.
He also thought about whether to take the opportunity to escape and stop venturing north with Nie Zhongyou.
But he immediately dismissed the idea.
Keeping promises is one thing, but if he leaves Nie Zhongyou, an official, he can only become a fugitive, which is an even worse choice.
So, the current problem is just how to find those people from Dali?
After morning exercise and eating, Li Xia pulled up the sleepy Bai Mao.
“Take you for a walk around the city. "
Bai Mao didn't know anything about the Gao family in Dali. He thought he was staying in Luzhou City just to rest. When he got up, he rubbed his eyes and complained non-stop.
"Liu Jinsuo's snoring is so crazy. If it wasn't for my mother, I would have left. There is no reason to suffer this. The life-locking golden gun, oh, it really locked up my life..."
Li Xia seemed not to have heard anything and took Bai Mao all the way to the vicinity of Changfeng Lane.
His eyes kept scanning the nearby crowd. Then, he took out the bronze medal from his arms and held it high.
"How about we go over there and watch a sideshow, and then go to a restaurant for a meal... I said, why don't you leave? Bai Mao asked: "What are you doing?" "
Li Xia didn't answer and said, "Want to eat at a restaurant? do you have money? "
"You didn't? "
"I don't. "
Bai Mao rolled his eyes and said with a smile: "It's not difficult to be rich, but is it possible? "
"There are people covering us, what are we afraid of? "
"Hey, that's settled... But what are you doing standing here holding this up? "
Li Xia didn't answer. This bad habit seemed to be infected from Nie Zhongyou.
After his eyes wandered for a while, he seemed to have discovered something, put down his hand, and put the bronze medal into his arms.
"Let's go. "
After walking with Bai Mao for a while, Li Xia suddenly whispered: "I'm bringing you out today because Nie Zhongyou has something to ask you to do... Do you see the man over there wearing a short-breasted coat of coarse cloth? "
"Saw it. "
"Don't you think it's strange? He was wearing broken straw sandals, but there was a purse hanging on his waist. "
Bai Mao whispered: "It's a little strange. "
"Go and steal him..."
After giving instructions to Bai Mao, Li Xia took a few steps back, walked to the street and stood there, continuing to scan the pedestrians on the street.
His eyes were as sharp as his age, like a goshawk looking for prey.
Suddenly, someone shouted from the other side of the street: “A thief? ! "
"Come on, there's a thief! "
Li Xia turned around and took a look, and saw that the man in a coarse cloth had tightly grasped Bai Mao's hand and was shouting loudly.
Not far away, several police officers were coming here.
With just a quick glance, Li Xia withdrew his gaze and scanned the pedestrians on the street again...
"Stealing something! "
"Catch him! "
Several policemen rushed forward and held Bai Mao down. The scene became chaotic.
"It's unfair, I didn't steal anything from him, I just bumped into him accidentally, really! "
Bai Mao shouted, and then shouted to the sky: "Go back quickly and ask your brothers to save me. I was wronged..."
"Stop talking nonsense! Take people back! "
"..."
In the crowd, Fan San watched this scene and winked at his companion Feng Sheng, signaling him to report the matter to Lu Fengtai immediately...
